For $Y\in \mathcal F\mathcal M$, let $\gamma _{Y_a}$ be the parallel transport of $Y$ along a curve with initial velocity $Y_a$. Define $ abla _a|_Y=(d/dt)|_{0}\gamma _{Y_a}(t)$. In local coordinates, \[ abla _a=y_a^j\left( rac{\partial }{\partial \widetilde x^j} -y_b^k\Gamma ^i_{kj} rac{\partial }{\partial y_b^i} ight). \]
